notes.title: Shimagami : Last Hope v1.07
notes.content:
[b]1. New System : Reborn[/b]

What is Reborn ?

You can reset your characters stats and earn Aorei. 


[b]2. NPC Added[/b]

- Reborn NPC
- Wandering NPC
(More in next patches)

And Bug Fixes

notes.title: Shimagami : Last Hope v1.05
notes.content:
Bug Fix :

Problem not saving story fragments

“Unstuck” button that can be used in case of getting stuck on the map

Open and close the main menu with the “ESC” key

Master Volume and Music volume adjustment

Fixed jamming in the parkour section

Some other small bugs
